# LCD17/19 EDID fixture

These 128 live-DDC bytes come from console capture `20261031T041513Z-metal`,
`GT710_NATIVE.edid`; SHA-256
`07da84b6557390f56c0b274dd93cc9a6e09f14684bc97b87e9978cdb0d86ff2c`.
The preferred DTD is 1280x1024 at 108 MHz. Established-timing byte 36 bit 0
advertises 1280x1024 at 75 Hz (DMT 24h). The range descriptor advertises
49..76 Hz vertical, 25..81 kHz horizontal and a 160 MHz pixel-clock limit.
The fixture contains EDID only, with no board ROM or site configuration.
